{"metadata":{"description":"Unattended scheduled jobs for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): agent/command tasks on cron schedules","id":"gh:1347064636","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-cron","slug":"squirrel20/dsh-cron","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Unattended scheduled jobs for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): agent/command tasks on cron schedules"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-cron"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Unattended scheduled-jobs plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): run **agent tasks** (spawn a one-shot a"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"gent to execute a prompt through the full dsh toolchain) or **command tasks** (run a script directly"},{"id":"p4s3","text":") on a cron expression, a fixed interval, or a one-time instant. Complementary to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"schedule` — that one is persistent in-session reminders, this one is a host-side job scheduler: jobs"},{"id":"p4s5","text":" belong to no interactive session and fire automatically while the process is up."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## UI"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Sidebar section**: status dot (last result) + next-trigger time, live elapsed timer while runnin"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"g; rows expand into run history; clicking an agent run jumps straight to that run's full session, an"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"d clicking a command run opens a run-detail page over the center column (status, duration, exit code"},{"id":"p6s4","text":", command, output tail).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Three trigger kinds**: `cron` (5-field expression + explicit IANA `timeZone`; the process time z"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"one is never consulted), `everySeconds` (anchor-aligned interval, 60s minimum), `at` (one-time RFC 3"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"339 instant; a Z or numeric offset is required).
- **Three ways to declare a job**: profile config ("},{"id":"p8s4","text":"declarative, versioned with the profile), the runtime overlay (`+` in the sidebar, or `cron_create` "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"from a session — persisted as "manual" jobs), and other plugins through the `cron` service (`ctx.cro"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"n.registerJob`, see Adding jobs from a plugin).
- **Three task kinds**: `agent` (create a one-shot a"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"gent via `ctx.agents.create`, submit the prompt, wait for quiescence, take the last assistant messag"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"e as the summary, dispose to finish — i.e. the dsh-headless one-shot recipe); `command` (spawn a chi"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ld process, record exit code and output tail); `callback` (a plugin-registered handler run in this p"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"rocess — plugin jobs only, see Adding jobs from a plugin).
- **Persistent state**: job dispatch stat"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"e and run history live in the storage domain layer (`ctx.storage.domain`, domain name `cron`), never"},{"id":"p8s12","text":" in session event logs.
- **Reliability semantics**: at-most-once per occurrence (`lastFiredMs` is p"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ersisted before execution); missed occurrences are never replayed one by one (the misfire policy run"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"s at most once, against the latest due occurrence); runs interrupted by a crash are repaired to `abo"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"rted` on the next startup.
- **Policies**: `overlap: skip | queue | replace` (when the previous run "},{"id":"p8s16","text":"is still going: skip / queue the latest one occurrence / kill and restart); `misfire: skip | runOnce"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"` (occurrences missed while the process was down: ignore / catch up once).
- **Delivery**: optional "},{"id":"p8s18","text":"delivery command; the run record is fed as JSON on stdin (fires only on failure by default).
- **Clo"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"ck discipline** (inherited from dsh-schedule): long waits are chunked and the wall clock is re-read "},{"id":"p8s20","text":"on every wake-up — a backwards clock jump never fires early, a forwards jump is handled as overdue."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### From the Plugin Market"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Security and upgrading"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Cron jobs are **host administration**, not sandboxed extensions of the creating session. Mutating co"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nversation tools require the session's effective sandbox to be `danger-full-access` and approval pol"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"icy to be `never`. Preset names alone do not grant access; Auto, custom/unresolved permissions, and "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"missing permission services fail closed. Read tools remain available. Restricted sessions should pro"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"duce a proposed spec for operator review instead of creating or triggering jobs. This release delibe"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"rately does not offer confined-session cron execution."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Existing manual jobs without a matching authorization record are retained with history, but quaran"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tined (`requiresApproval: true`). Review the complete task, access, cwd and delivery command, then *"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"*Edit → Save** to authorize that exact spec. Enable and Run now cannot bypass quarantine. New/edited"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" manual jobs store an authorization digest and creator session ID when available; dispatch and deliv"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ery recheck the stored authorization. This is standing authorization, independent of the creator ses"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"sion's lifetime. Pause/delete the job to revoke future runs; stop any active run separately.
- Web w"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"rites require `Authorization: Bearer <webControlToken>`. Set the plugin's `webControlToken` to a ran"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"dom secret of at least 32 characters; unset/short tokens disable web writes. Generate it with `opens"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"sl rand -hex 32` and store it in protected host configuration, outside any agent-readable workspace."},{"id":"p14s10","text":" The UI asks for it in a password dialog, keeps it only in memory, and clears it after a 403. Never "},{"id":"p14s11","text":"supply it to a restricted agent. Use HTTPS when connecting remotely. Neither read endpoints nor job "},{"id":"p14s12","text":"specs expose the token.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Boundaries and known limitations"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Agent runs carry a fixed `[CRON RUN]` framing that states the run is unattended and questions are "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"forbidden. It is injected as a scoped system-prompt section, so the user message holds only the job'"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"s prompt; hosts without the system-prompt service fall back to prepending it to the message.
- Confi"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"g jobs come from plugin config (declarative); the conversational tools (`cron_list` / `cron_runs` / "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"`cron_run_now` / `cron_enable` / `cron_disable`) observe and steer them but never create or delete t"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"hem. Runtime "manual" jobs are the exception: `cron_create` / `cron_delete` manage those from a sess"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ion, guided by the bundled `cron-create` skill (registered into the host's skill registry when one e"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"xists), through the same `manual`-table overlay as the web dialog.
- Plugin-registered jobs (`source"},{"id":"p16s9","text":": "plugin"`) are owned by their provider package: they can be run, paused and inspected, but not edi"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"ted or deleted from the overlay or a session — that is what installing and uninstalling the provider"},{"id":"p16s11","text":" is for. Unmounting a provider leaves an orphan row holding the job's history until the user deletes"},{"id":"p16s12","text":" it.
- `queue` depth is 1: only the single latest squeezed-out occurrence is kept.
- A run's Session"},{"id":"p16s13","text":" is a plain durable Session (the `dsh-headless` shape), so its conversation stays openable after the"},{"id":"p16s14","text":" run settles. A conversation that is on screen at that exact moment returns to the workspace, and th"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"e run row reopens the persisted transcript (the client re-pulls the host session list once when the "},{"id":"p16s16","text":"id is no longer listed). Run Sessions persisted by earlier versions still carry the `origin: "subage"},{"id":"p16s17","text":"nt"` header and stay unopenable.
- Because a run's Session is plain, the host no longer refuses prom"},{"id":"p16s18","text":"pts to it: opening a run while it is still going and typing into it adds a user turn to the unattend"},{"id":"p16s19","text":"ed run (that turn can surface in the run's summary), and the run's settle then returns that conversa"},{"id":"p16s20","text":"tion to the workspace.
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
